| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Window size** `size` | 5 | 3 to 15, odd px | Width and height of the window. |
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 10 | 0.5 to 100 | The standard deviation of the noise, in 8-bit levels. |
| **Range factor k** `k` | 2 | 0.5 to 4 | Values within k times sigma of the center are averaged. Lee uses 2, which holds about 95 percent of Gaussian noise. |
| **Minimum count** `minCount` | 3 | 1 to 25 | When fewer values than this are in range, counting the center, the center is a spot of noise. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
